page.notes: Right-hand column head "N," is a letter heading. The drop-cap N of "Nancitor" is read as the first letter of the entry. Doubtful readings: "χαλὸν" (Greek after "Neruus Græcis"); "101.d." after "Noctu iudicare" (figure partly obscured); "Νομοφυλακες" (Greek, accents uncertain); "agnā" (abbreviation mark unclear); "Noctu posse transfigi" line not checked against scan closely. Entry "Nominalia ... 174.lz." copied as printed. Wrapped lines have been joined into single entries. No page number printed. No catchword. Shelf marks and stamps not present.
